name: Lumina Studio Pro Universal Cross-Platform Feature Registry
platforms: Modern Web Browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge)

features.name: Tri-Modal Adaptive Layout Engine (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile)
features.description: Real-time viewport classification into Desktop (>1024px), Tablet (768-1024px), and Mobile (<768px) with native-adapted navigation hierarchies, sidebars, and bottom action sheets.

features.name: Professional Desktop Menu Bar System
features.description: OS-native application menu bar with File, Edit, Image, Layer, View, Tools, Cloud, and Help cascades with keyboard shortcut badging and hardware tier telemetry.

features.name: Contextual Workstation Status Bar
features.description: Displays live canvas dimensions, color profile, bit depth, active tool, memory tier, zero-data-loss indicator, and quick-toggle before/after split controls.

features.name: Unified Input & Stylus Normalization
features.description: Multi-modal input abstraction handling keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl bindings), mouse wheel zooming, touch gestures (pinch-to-zoom, 2-finger pan), and Apple Pencil/S-Pen pressure and tilt.

features.name: Capacitor Native Hardware Integration
features.description: Direct bridge to native device haptics, status bar styling, safe area insets (notches/pill cutouts), hardware back button handlers, and low-memory emergency eviction.

features.name: Centralized Universal Settings Hub
features.description: Comprehensive settings console managing performance tiers, worker concurrency, WebGL fallback, shortcut customization, storage quotas, and live GPU diagnostics.

features.name: Tier 1-4 Hardware Capability Classifier
features.description: Introspects GPU renderer, unmasked vendor, CPU cores, memory limits, and touch points to classify hardware into Ultra Workstation (Tier 4), Standard Desktop (Tier 3), High-End Mobile/Tablet (Tier 2), or Constrained (Tier 1).

features.name: Dynamic 32-Bit Float vs 16-Bit Half Float Precision
features.description: Automatically configures IEEE 754 32-bit floating point color pipeline on Tier 3-4 machines and memory-efficient 16-bit half-float on Tier 1-2 mobile devices.

features.name: LRU Tile Memory & Emergency Eviction
features.description: Scales viewport tile sizes (256px, 512px, 1024px) based on device memory and automatically flushes non-visible tiles under OS memory pressure warnings.

features.name: RAW Bayer Demosaicing & Lens Optics Engine
features.description: Full DNG/CR2/NEF/ARW demosaicing with AHD interpolation, chromatic aberration correction, vignette compensation, and 14-bit dynamic range extraction.

features.name: Wide Gamut Color Management (ProPhoto, P3, sRGB, AdobeRGB)
features.description: Color space transforms with perceptual and relative colorimetric intent, gamut clip warning overlays, and soft proofing profiles.

features.name: Parametric Tone, Curve & HSL Mixer
features.description: Real-time exposure, contrast, shadows, highlights, white balance Kelvin, RGB channel curves, 8-channel hue/saturation/luminance separation, and clarity engine.

features.name: Multi-Layer Selective Masking Engine
features.description: Brush, linear gradient, radial gradient, luminance range, and color range masks with independent non-destructive adjustment stacks.

features.name: 6-Pillar Scene Understanding (Subjects, Objects, Light, Depth, Colors, Composition)
features.description: Neural segmentation parsing visual hierarchies, estimating scene depth maps, and identifying lighting direction for intelligent localized adjustments.

features.name: Context-Aware Neural Object Inpainting
features.description: Seamless generative background reconstruction removing unwanted elements, wires, and distractions.

features.name: Autonomous AI Creative Director
features.description: Analyzes photographic style, genre, and aesthetic balance to propose multi-layer non-destructive edit plans tailored to individual scenes.

features.name: Atmospheric AI Sky Replacement & Relighting
features.description: Horizon-aware sky segmentation with atmospheric color harmonization, edge blending, and foreground relighting.

categories.name: Local-First Persistence, Disaster Recovery & Cloud Collaboration

features.name: Local-First IndexedDB Persistent Database
features.description: 100% client-side persistence storing projects, edit histories, high-resolution original bitmaps, custom presets, and user preferences offline.

features.name: Zero-Data-Loss Crash Recovery & Tab Synchronization
features.description: Periodic history snapshots, broadcast-channel multi-tab synchronization, conflict detection, and automated crash recovery prompts.

features.name: End-to-End Cloud Synchronization & Conflict Resolution
features.description: Real-time project synchronization across devices, 3-way visual conflict resolution with side-by-side branch merging.

features.name: Multi-User Live Collaboration & Client Review Studio
features.description: Pinpoint canvas comments, version comparison sliders, snapshot rollbacks, and distraction-free client presentation modes.
